mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courtship_matches(id, user_a_id, user_b_id, room_id, status) VALUES(#{id}, #{userAId}, #{userBId}, #{roomId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE courtship_matches SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.status, m.created_at, (CASE WHEN m.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN m.user_b_id ELSE m.user_a_id END) AS other_user_id, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS other_nickname, u.avatar_url AS other_avatar_url FROM courtship_matches m JOIN users u ON u.id = (CASE WHEN m.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN m.user_b_id ELSE m.user_a_id END) LEFT JOIN courtship_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.user_a_id = #{userId} OR m.user_b_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
